event.title: Xi Jinping Begins State Visit to Washington with Unusual Welcome from Trump
event.canonical_title: Xi Jinping Begins State Visit to Washington with Unusual Welcome from Trump
event.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping is set to arrive in Washington on Wednesday for a state visit, receiving a rare planeside welcome from President Donald Trump at Joint Base Andrews. This marks Xi's first state visit to the US in over a decade, highlighting the significance of the occasion.

timeline.title: Trump Greets Xi Jinping with Military Honors During State Visit
timeline.summary: Donald Trump welcomed Chinese President Xi Jinping at a military airbase in Maryland for a three-day state visit. This marked the first time a US president greeted a visiting leader on the tarmac, with the ceremony featuring a red carpet, military honors, and a flyover.
